chunks: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, he said: al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Ahmad al-Sa'igh narrated to us, he said: Abu Abdillah Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Khalili narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Abi Bakr al-Faqih, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Nawfali, from Ishaq ibn Yazid, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Zur'a ibn Muhammad, from al-Mufaddal ibn Umar, who said: I said to Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him): How was the birth of Fatima (peace be upon her)? So he said: Yes,

Indeed, when Khadija (peace be upon her) married the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family), the women of Mecca abandoned her. They would not visit her, nor greet her, nor allow any woman to visit her. Khadija (peace be upon her) became lonely because of that, and it was a source of distress, and her grief was a concern for him (may God bless him and his family).

When she became pregnant with Fatima (peace be upon her), she would speak to her from her womb and console her. She kept this hidden from the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family). One day, the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) entered and heard Khadija speaking to Fatima (peace be upon her), so he said to her: O Khadija, who are you speaking to? She said: The fetus in my womb speaks to me and keeps me company. He said: O Khadija, this is Gabriel informing me that she is a female, and that she is the pure and blessed offspring, and that God, Blessed and Exalted, will make my progeny from her, and will make Imams from her progeny, and will make them His vicegerents in His earth after the cessation of His revelation.

Khadija (peace be upon her) remained in that state until the time of her delivery came. She sent word to the women of Quraysh and Banu Hashim: Come and attend to me as women attend to women. They sent back to her: You disobeyed us and did not accept our words, and you married Muhammad, the orphan of Abu Talib, a poor man with no wealth. So we will not come, nor will we attend to any of your matter.

Khadija (peace be upon her) grieved because of that. While she was thus, suddenly four tall dark-complexioned women entered upon her, as if they were women from Banu Hashim. She was startled when she saw them. One of them said: Do not grieve, O Khadija, for we are messengers from your Lord to you, and we are your sisters. I am Sarah, and this is Asiya daughter of Muzahim, who is your companion in Paradise, and this is Maryam daughter of Imran, and this is Kulthum sister of Musa son of Imran. God sent us to you to attend to you as women attend to women.

One of them sat to her right, another to her left, the third in front of her, and the fourth behind her. Fatima (peace be upon her) was born pure and purifying. When she came to the ground, a light shone from her that entered the houses of Mecca, and there remained no place in the east of the earth nor its west except that light illuminated it.

Ten of the dark-eyed beauties (hur al-ayn) entered, each of them carrying a basin from Paradise and a pitcher from Paradise, and in the pitcher was water from al-Kawthar. The woman who was in front of her took her and washed her with water from al-Kawthar. She brought out two white cloths, whiter than milk and more fragrant than musk and ambergris. She wrapped her in one and veiled her with the second.

Then she made her speak, and Fatima (peace be upon her) spoke with the two testimonies and said: I bear witness that there is no god except God, and that my father is the Messenger of God and the Master of the Prophets, and that my husband is the Master of the Successors, and my children are the Masters of the Tribes.

Then she greeted them and called each one of them by her name. They began to smile at her, and the dark-eyed beauties rejoiced, and the people of the heaven gave glad tidings to one another over the birth of Fatima (peace be upon her). A radiant light appeared in the heaven that the angels had never seen before. The women said: Take her, O Khadija, pure, purified, righteous, and blessed. Blessed be she and her progeny. So she received her, happy and delighted, and breastfed her, and milk flowed for her. Fatima (peace be upon her) would grow in one day as a child grows in a month, and she would grow in a month as a child grows in a year.

key_terms.الحور العين: The dark-eyed beauties of Paradise (Hur al-Ayn)
key_terms.الشهادتين: The two testimonies of Islamic faith (shahada)
key_terms.الكوثر: Al-Kawthar - the heavenly river/fountain of abundance mentioned in Quran 108:1
key_terms.النسلة الطاهرة الميمونة: The pure and blessed offspring - referring to Fatima (SA)
key_terms.سادة الأسباط: Masters of the Tribes - referring to the Imams from Fatima's lineage

ai.seo_question: How was Lady Fatima al-Zahra (SA) born according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates the miraculous birth of Lady Fatima al-Zahra (SA). When Khadija (SA) married the Prophet (SAWW), the women of Mecca ostracized her. During pregnancy, Fatima spoke to her mother from the womb. At the time of delivery, the Meccan women refused to help, but four holy women - Sarah, Asiya, Maryam, and Kulthum - were sent by God to assist. Fatima was born radiating light that illuminated the entire world, and she immediately bore witness to God's oneness, her father's prophethood, her husband Ali's successorship, and her children's leadership.
